text:
The change raises the OSPF cost on one interface each of CHM and SEA from 10 to 100. I'm assuming these are the two ends of the same link, but the diff doesn't name the peer interface, so the tests don't depend on it. The adjacency should stay up. Routes should not disappear, though the best path may shift. Reachability should be unchanged because only metrics changed, and the conv and load tests check that the traffic shift doesn't create a problem.
